$comment: cmux.wire/1 vectors for the cmux-next Cloud ops (plans/cmux-next/cloud-client-contract.md 1.3 and 1.4). Shared by the client tests (first-party-apps/cloud/server) and the backend tests. Synthetic data only. Generated by backend/packages/protocol/scripts/export-cloud-vectors.ts.

conventions.request: POST http.path with {op, params, idempotency_key?}; reads have no key. `backend_only` bind cases POST params as the whole body to /v1/cloud/bind with no bearer (the one-time bind token is the credential).
conventions.responses: One entry per attempt with the same (principal, op, params, idempotency_key): attempt i gets responses[i], later attempts the last entry.
conventions.read_error: A read error is the HTTP error body {_tag, code, message} at http.status.
conventions.principal: kind install or session; agent set = a chief token (claim agt).
conventions.revision: Decimal string: the team owner's (CloudDO) event sequence at the entity's last change, so entity and list revisions compare. A client drops an event or answer older than what it holds.
